title: Caleb Ramsey
text: I’m a Virginia Tech graduate with degrees in Statistics and Sports Media & Analytics. I build analytics projects, visual reports, and reproducible workflows in R, with work spanning team-facing dashboards, scouting tools, NBA/WNBA analysis, and shot quality modeling.

title: Caleb Ramsey
text:
Featured Work

Practice Hustle Dashboard — R Shiny + Quarto dashboard for tracking practice performance trends and evaluating practice-to-game relationships.
Scouting Card & Badge System — Automated player cards using Synergy playtype data, percentile grading logic, and custom R visualization workflows.
TipOffBall Analytics — NBA/WNBA analysis workflows, visual reports, and public-facing basketball writing.
Shot Quality Pipeline — Prototype pipeline using NBA Stats API play-by-play and shot chart data to model contextual shot value.
